chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from some of our companions, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
If the guardian of the slain person dies, his child takes his place after him regarding the blood claim.

key_terms.بِٱلدَّمِ: regarding the blood claim, meaning the right tied to retaliation or legal claim for the killing
key_terms.وَلَدُهُ: his child, who succeeds to the claim
key_terms.وَلِيُّ ٱلْمَقْتُولِ: the legal guardian or entitled claimant of the slain person

ai.seo_question: Who inherits the right to seek retribution if the guardian of a murdered person dies?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the right connected to a slain person's blood. It states that if the wali of the murdered person dies, his child succeeds to his position in pursuing that claim.
